concerns.text: Task T043 ('Theory Embarrassment detector') is tagged with [FR-003, SC-001]. FR-003 requires collecting p-values, which is covered by T022c. SC-001 requires measuring KS deviation, covered by T028b. T043's description ('flags specific simulation runs... report full range') does not map to the specific requirements of FR-003 or SC-001, creating a stale tag. The task implements a specific visualization/reporting feature (FR-007/SC-002) but is incorrectly tagged for FR-003/SC-001.

Task T043-raw is tagged with [FR-007]. FR-007 requires 'sensitivity analysis sweeping the correlation threshold... and report how the KS statistic varies'. T043-raw generates an 'embarrassment log' of high deviations. While related, the specific requirement to 'sweep' and 'report variation' is explicitly covered by T029 (Sensitivity Analysis). T043-raw appears to be a duplicate or mis-tagged implementation of the 'worst-case' identification rather than the full sweep required by FR-007.

Task T044 is tagged with [FR-005, SC-001]. FR-005 requires 'QQ-plots'. T044 generates a 'Reality Check' composite plot. While it includes a QQ-like comparison, the specific requirement for 'QQ-plots' is explicitly covered by T028c. T044 is a reviewer-requested visualization (not a mandatory FR) and should not be tagged as the primary implementation of FR-005, creating a stale tag.

Task T045 is tagged with [Constitution Principle IV, FR-007]. FR-007 is the sensitivity analysis. T045 is a documentation update task. While it extracts data from the sensitivity analysis, the task itself is documentation, not the implementation of the FR-007 requirement (which is T029). Tagging a documentation task as the implementation of a functional requirement is a coverage mismatch.

Task T048 is tagged with [Review: Feynman]. This is a reviewer-requested task, not a Spec FR/SC. It should not be tagged with a functional requirement ID if one exists, or should be untagged if it's purely a 'nice-to-have' visualization. If it claims to satisfy an FR, that FR must be identified. Currently, it has no FR tag, which is correct, but the 'Review' tag is not a standard FR/SC tag and may confuse traceability.

Task T049 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked). It is required to satisfy the 'Reviewer Revision' phase logic (T050, T051 depend on it). More critically, T049 is the only task explicitly implementing the 'Failure Mode Classifier' logic required to identify the 'worst-case' scenario for the 'Feynman Honesty' section (T051). Without T049, the 'worst-case' identification required by the plan's 'Reviewer Revision' logic is missing.

Task T030 is tagged with [Constitution Principle VII, FR-007]. Constitution Principle VII requires 'KS statistic + bootstrap CI'. T030 implements this. However, FR-007 is 'sensitivity analysis'. T030 is not the sensitivity analysis (T029 is). The tag [FR-007] is stale/misapplied here. T030 satisfies Constitution Principle VII, but not FR-007.

Task T022c is tagged with [US2]. It implements p-value collection. This is correct. However, T022c is the ONLY task covering FR-003 ('collect exactly p p-values'). If T022c fails or is removed, FR-003 has no coverage. This is a single point of failure in coverage, but currently valid.

Task T028b is tagged with [US3]. It implements KS statistic calculation. This covers FR-004. However, T028b is the ONLY task covering FR-004. If T028b fails, FR-004 has no coverage. This is a single point of failure, but currently valid.

Task T028c is tagged with [US3]. It implements QQ-plots. This covers FR-005. However, T028c is the ONLY task covering FR-005. If T028c fails, FR-005 has no coverage. This is a single point of failure, but currently valid.

Task T029 is tagged with [US3]. It implements sensitivity analysis. This covers FR-007. However, T029 is the ONLY task covering FR-007. If T029 fails, FR-007 has no coverage. This is a single point of failure, but currently valid.
